notes.title: Discount on «Underwater»
notes.notes:
To celebrate the start of the school year, we have made a 50% discount on the game «Underwater»!
Go, in the person of an unknown prisoner, to an underwater prison, where dangerous mutants roam ...

notes.title: The first patch
notes.notes:
Fixed the time of displaying hints during the first selection of important things
Added some graphic elements
Added the hero's thoughts when using things that can't be used yet
Fix the AI of the monster that did not pass near the door
Fix for changing the volume of effects in the game
Added a glowing text on the code panel(players began to get confused)
Fixed key descriptions

notes.title: Underwater is available on Steam!
notes.notes:
Half a year of development. A month of testing and improvements. Complete rework of the game based on feedback. And now, horror [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1676200]Underwater[/url][/b] ready.

The new horror game Underwater will remind you of what real horror stories should look like without giving the player the right to make mistakes. Go, in the person of an unknown prisoner, to an underwater prison, where dangerous mutants roam...

notes.title: Stream from the developer
notes.notes: We play [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1676200]Underwater [/url][/b]and communicate with the developer, as well as share comments and tips regarding the passage of the game
